info.name: CareLayer API
info.description: CareLayer backend (apps/api). Contract: docs/API_CONTRACT.md (v1). One folder per module; folders are added by the task that builds each module (Z3 Auth, Z5 Top-up, Z6 Chat + Questions, Z7 Nurse cases, Z9 Nurse profile + Admin). Select the 'CareLayer local' environment ({{baseUrl}} = [http://localhost:4000](http://localhost:4000)).

Woman only. Send the whole thread she sees (oldest first, last turn = hers). Saved to her account: her message and the reply are added to the conversation `conversationId` (omit it to start a new chat; another woman's id is 404). Nothing is saved if the assistant fails, so a retry never duplicates. Returns { kind: "reply", message, escalationOffer, conversationId } or an EmergencyResponse with conversationId (her message is saved, no reply follows). conversationId is null only if saving failed. Red flags are checked before the LLM. 12 requests/min per woman. Contract §7.

Woman only (signed-in session; agent tokens are refused). Her saved chats, most recently active first: Page<ConversationSummary> = { items: [{ id, title, preview, messageCount, createdAt, updatedAt }], nextCursor }. title = start of her first message, preview = start of the last message. Cache-Control: no-store. Contract §7.

Woman only (signed-in session). One saved chat: Conversation = { id, title, createdAt, updatedAt, messages: [{ id, role, text, emergency, createdAt }], questions: [{ questionId, createdAt }] }, oldest first. emergency = her message raised an emergency (no reply follows it). questions = questions she sent to a nurse from this chat (POST /questions with conversationId); the app shows each in the chat with its status and answer (GET /me/questions/:id). 404 NOT_FOUND if it does not exist or is not hers. The app uses it to reopen a chat after a reload (/ask?c=id) or from History. Contract §7.

Woman only (signed-in session). Deletes the chat and all its messages. 204 No Content. 404 NOT_FOUND if it does not exist or is not hers. Questions she sent to nurses are separate and are not affected. Contract §7.

header.description: x402 v2 payment (base64 JSON), sent on the paid retry. Leave {{paymentSignature}} empty for the first call. Agents build it from the PAYMENT-REQUIRED header (e.g. @x402/fetch). The web app uses Collect instead.

request.description:
Z8. x402-protected answer (contract §8.3). Steps, in order:
1. Owner check: 404 if not hers.
2. Answered guard: 410 QUESTION_EXPIRED if expired, else 409 QUESTION_NOT_ANSWERED unless answered. No payment is asked for.
3. Already collected: the same answer and receipt again, never charged twice.
4. Free (one of her first 3): 200 straight away, paidFromTreasury true, nothing charged. The treasury pays the nurse 80%.
5. Paid: without PAYMENT-SIGNATURE → 402 + PAYMENT-REQUIRED (exact USDC stroops to the platform, Stellar testnet). With it: verify → record attempt → settle → answer + PAYMENT-RESPONSE (settlement tx hash). The nurse's 80% payout is sent right after.

Settle failed → 402 (no answer text, nothing recorded as paid). Facilitator busy/down → 503 retryable. Settle timeout → 503 paymentPending; the next call checks the chain before asking for money again.

request.description: Z8/Z12. The web app's way to get an answer (W11); Claude uses it too with an agent token. Free if she has one of her first 3 left (nothing signed). Otherwise it checks her spending limit (409 SPENDING_LIMIT_EXCEEDED unless approvedAboveLimit: true; with an agent token Claude's own limit applies and approvedAboveLimit is ignored), then her live balance (409 INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE), then pays over x402 from her custodial wallet. With an agent token and "ask before each payment" on: 409 PAYMENT_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED until confirmPayment: true. Calling again returns the same answer without paying again.

request.description:
Z10. Real testnet payment from her CareLayer wallet; the platform pays the Stellar fee (fee bump).
First: Auth → request a code with purpose "step_up", then POST /auth/step-up { code } (valid 5 minutes on this session).
Rules: Stellar address only (bank is "Coming soon"), minimum ₦100, at most `available`, one withdrawal at a time. The destination must exist and trust testnet USDC, and must not be her own CareLayer wallet.
memo (optional): only when the receiving wallet asks for one; exchanges credit deposits by memo. type "id" (digits, up to 2^64-1; most exchanges) or "text" (up to 28 bytes). Remove it for a personal wallet.
201 status "confirmed" (hash recorded) or "submitted" (Stellar was slow: it becomes confirmed or failed within about 3 minutes; check GET /nurse/withdrawals). 502 STELLAR_SUBMIT_FAILED = Stellar refused it, nothing left her wallet.
